notes: Deterministic evaluation of the Strategic Intelligence projection. Semantic answers from the live provider are evaluated separately by the human-only Brando smoke; these fixtures never call a provider.

fixtures.name: coherent strategy
fixtures.notes: nine decisions decided in canonical order, Priority Experiment executed; no invented conflicts

fixtures.name: clear HARD inconsistency
fixtures.notes: an active decision relies on a hypothesis a human rejected

fixtures.name: subtle tension
fixtures.notes: an active decision relies on a hypothesis a human has since weakened: caution, not contradiction

fixtures.name: weak evidence
fixtures.notes: low-quality, indirect evidence is limited support, never a probability

fixtures.name: unvalidated hypothesis
fixtures.notes: a hypothesis without evidence leaves the decision unvalidated

fixtures.name: upstream change with downstream pending
fixtures.notes: HARD review first, suggestion after; follow-ups are explanation only

fixtures.name: declared market differs from operating location
fixtures.notes: declared geography is context, never the Market Arena decision, which stays unchanged

fixtures.name: decision taken before its basis
fixtures.notes: Core Message decided while its HARD basis Brand Promise is undecided: INFO guidance, never a contradiction
